creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The README says CI runs exactly what ./dev runs, and there is no CI - no .github/workflows at all. The claim should be true or the sentence should go.

Most of the cost is already paid: deps/herdr.pin fetches and checksums the daemon, deps/ghostty.pin builds libghostty, and ./dev with no flags is the whole gate. What a workflow adds is caching those two (libghostty is minutes cold) and choosing which platforms to run - macOS is where the shell builds, and the Linux container is where the herdr corpus gets diffed (a_26BJG8nDs).
title: 🏗️ CI: run the gate on every push
